title: 12-name watchlist · 07 Nov 2026 (Sat) · 04:00 SGT
summary: NVIDIA reports wider adoption of wireless research software; Meta introduces custom Muse spaces. An earlier Microsoft data-center protest report is added as a coverage correction. Shared AI financing-risk context is separated from company developments. All 12 saved closes and 72 adjusted-close return baselines were rechecked.
coverage_note: Fixed cutoff: 7 November 04:00 SGT (6 November 20:00 UTC). Incremental window: 6 November 23:30 SGT to the cutoff, covering the previous 7 November 00:00 SGT edition with a 30-minute overlap. Microsoft’s 20:47:37 SGT article predates that window and is explicitly a late-observed coverage correction. Reuters access is partial; search-retrieved article text is distinguished from direct issuer evidence. Eleven accessible SEC feeds contained no filings accepted during the window; Amazon’s previously unavailable feed was not retried. No new item for a quiet name does not mean no news occurred. Prior editions remain unchanged.
price_basis: USD regular-session closes for 5 Nov 2026, the latest completed US session at cutoff. Fresh Yahoo daily bars retrieved 6 Nov 20:00:06–20:00:15 UTC independently recheck all 12 historical closes and 72 adjusted-close baselines. Exact Nov 5 vendor quote timestamps are preserved from archived raw evidence whose quoted prices match those fresh bars; they are not newly observed historical timestamps. Current Nov 6 intraday metadata and prices are excluded, and no Nov 6 closing prices are claimed. Daily changes compare Nov 5 with Nov 4 ordinary closes; adjusted closes are separate cumulative-return endpoints. BRK.B quote time is 21:04:07 UTC; other quote times are 21:00:01 or 21:00:02 UTC. TSM is the US-listed USD ADR. These saved observations are not live.
return_basis: Six cumulative 1–6 month returns use Yahoo adjusted closes, adjusted for splits and dividend/capital-gain distributions. Formula: (endpoint adjusted close / baseline adjusted close - 1) x 100. Source values are rounded to cents before independent Decimal arithmetic; percentages are rounded to two decimals. Baselines are the latest available sessions on or before each monthly anniversary: 5 Oct, 4 Sep, 5 Aug, 2 Jul, 5 Jun and 5 May 2026. Returns are not annualised and exclude investor fees, tax and FX.
caveats: News access is partial. Reuters reporting is attributed separately from issuer statements and research analysis; search silence does not establish absence of news.
Amazon SEC and Micron IR prior HTTP 403 responses were respected without retry. Alphabet IR direct access remained unavailable.

NVIDIA’s 16:00:35 UTC article was after the prior cutoff and is eligible now. Its saved original HTML was inspected and current issuer search corroborated its contents; direct web opening remained unavailable. Meta’s 18:00:58 UTC publication was verified from retrieved original HTML.

Microsoft’s article predates the overlap window and corrects an earlier coverage omission. Previously reported Apple financing, Alphabet holdings and Amazon text shopping are not repeated as new events.

The shared Reuters credit-risk item is market context, not an operating development or credit event at any watchlist issuer. Its reported market levels are dated snapshots, separate from the saved November 5 stock-price tables.

Price and baseline verification uses Yahoo Finance only, not independent cross-vendor corroboration. Historical exact quote times derive from preserved earlier raw evidence; fresh daily-bar checks do not invent replacement timestamps.

Adjusted closes include the vendor’s split and distribution adjustments. Cents-first return arithmetic is reproducible from displayed inputs and may differ slightly from calculations using unrounded values.
